updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git-lfs && git lfs install && git lfs pull && sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --no-cache-dir --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --no-cache-dir --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
